title: Product
description: One OTC product package, identified by its NDC. Produced by the identity stage (NOMI-025, NOMI-026); read by scoring and the app.

spl_set_id.description: DailyMed label set id, stable across label versions.

brand_name.description: Name on the box, e.g. 'Tylenol Extra Strength'.

generic_name.description: Generic name of the active ingredients, e.g. 'acetaminophen'.

dosage_form.description: Dosage form from the NDC directory, e.g. 'TABLET, COATED'.

marketing_category.description: How the product is legally sold, from the NDC directory.

otc_category.description: Our OTC grouping, e.g. 'internal_analgesics' or 'antacids' (values assigned in NOMI-026). Null for out-of-scope products.

uses.description: Consumer uses from the label, e.g. ['pain', 'fever'] (taxonomy in NOMI-047).

scope.description: Whether Nomi scores this product. Homeopathic products are shown but not scored.

inactive_ingredients.description: Inactive ingredients, used for allergen and excipient checks.

active_ingredient.title: ActiveIngredient
active_ingredient.description: One active ingredient and its strength, e.g. 500 mg, or 650 mg per 30 mL for liquids.

name.description: Ingredient name as on the label, e.g. 'acetaminophen'.

per_amount.description: For liquids and similar forms: the amount the strength is per, e.g. 30.

inactive_ingredient.title: InactiveIngredient
inactive_ingredient.description: One inactive ingredient. UNII may be missing on some labels.

name.description: Ingredient name as on the label, e.g. 'FD&C red no. 40'.
